name: notion
description: Access Notion pages, databases, tasks, and workspace members via Notion's official hosted OAuth MCP server (mcp.notion.com). Create documentation, search content, manage tasks, build reports, and plan campaigns. Browser OAuth — no API keys.

connection.instructions: Click Connect to sign in with your Notion account. You will be redirected to Notion's OAuth authorization page — grant the requested permissions and you will be returned to the workspace. No API keys or tokens are required.
